text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: model-route redwood/galactica-int8-calib p99 latency 1.2s (SLO 700ms) across eu-west-1. p95 also elevated. Paging oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. grabbing traces + current rollout state.

kevin: saw the rollout yesterday — we pushed an int8 calibration tweak for galactica-v2 which introduced a new fused-dequant kernel. rolled to 10% traffic at 02:15 UTC then 50% at 08:00.

maria: telemetry: streaming stalls spike correlates with calibration rollout. p95 from 320ms -> 610ms, p99 -> 1.2s. lots of streaming sessions timeout at chunk 3-4.

jia: grabbing logs for an impacted node:```
2026-03-14T08:23:05Z model=galactica-v2 node=gpu-71k sv=redwood/galactica-int8-calib stream_id=abc123 stall=kv_dequant_wait duration_ms=920
2026-03-14T08:23:06Z trace=tx-44 error=stream_chunk_timeout
```

sam: hypothesis: the new calibration path shifts to a dequant implementation that holds the KV cache lock slightly longer under certain seq_len patterns -> locking contention on streaming mux. that would create tail stalls.

kevin: +1. metrics show per-shard queueing up when sequence length > 2048 and with high concurrency. kernel profiling shows a GC-like pause in the dequant stage.

alia: ops-bot initiated an automatic rollback attempt earlier but it failed due to dependency graph mismatch on canary nodes. i can run a manual partial rollback if we decide.

oncall-alex: we need a live mitigation first. options: 1) route streaming traffic to the fp16 variant (redwood/galactica-fp16) for affected routes, 2) disable the new calibration flag on the model-serving config (fast but riskier), 3) scale out specific shards to reduce contention (slower). preferences?

maria: customer-impact: 12 paid tenants in eu-west-1 saw transient stalls and a few 5xx errors on HTTP streaming. CS already alerted top 3 customers with escalations.

kevin: routing to fp16 is safest — preserves behavior with slightly higher cost. can we do targeted routing by route tag (chat-streaming) to limit blast radius?

sam: yes, we have route-aware traffic steering. I can push a routing policy to send chat-streaming to fp16 for eu-west-1 within 2 minutes.

ops-bot: :deploy: Deploy started by sam - routing-policy/2026-03-14-08:28:10 -> target redwood/galactica-fp16 for route:chat-stream.

oncall-alex: executing. please monitor p95/p99 and streaming error rate.

maria: 08:31 UTC p95 back to 340ms, p99 down to 710ms, streaming error rate dropping.

jia: confirming logs on previously hot node:```
2026-03-14T08:31:45Z model=galactica-fp16 node=gpu-71k stream_ok=1 latency_ms=320
```

kevin: good signal. that indicates the issue is isolated to the int8 calibration path. we should keep fp16 routing while we investigate root cause.

alia: i've queued a partial rollforward rollback for only the canary group (nodes labelled canary-calib). manual patch applied to remove the new fused-dequant for those nodes.

ops-bot: :deploy: Rollback applied on canary-calib group by alia at 2026-03-14T08:35:12Z.

maria: after rollback on canaries p99 for full region stabilized to 650ms. global p99 still slightly above SLO due to traffic mix, but eu-west-1 within threshold.

oncall-alex: next steps: 1) keep fp16 route active for chat-stream in eu-west-1 for next 6 hours, 2) revert full rollout of the int8 calibration (hold all further ramp), 3) create an actionable RCA to figure out fused-dequant lock behavior and heavy seq_len patterns.

kevin: agreed. early root cause: dequant kernel introduced a mutex over KV lookups to prevent races with a new prefetch path — under high concurrency and long sequences this serialized access and degraded tail. design fix candidates: per-slice locks or lock-free prefetch.

sam: i'll open a draft change to add per-slice mutex and small perf test harness that simulates long streaming sessions. will also add HT profiling to CI for future calibs.

alia: CS notes: top 3 customers notified, outreach template posted to #customer-success, recommend offering credits if they measured production impact.

maria: logging: create a short-lived alert to watch p99 and streaming 5xx in eu-west-1 at a lower threshold (p99 > 700ms) for the next 8 hours. i've set that.

oncall-alex: thanks team. I'll hand this off to kevin/jia for deeper investigation. oncall shift ends in 30m; paging should route to kevin as secondary if alerts fire.

kevin: taking follow-up. owners: kevin (RCA & kernel fix), sam (routing safeguard + test harness), maria (monitoring & CS comms).

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated: route->fp16 + partial rollback applied. Closed for now; reopen if alerts re-trigger within 1h.

alia: postmortem owner assignment will be confirmed after initial RCA. initial blameless notes saved to /incidents/2032109999/postmortem-draft.

oncall-alex: final note: avoid full rollouts of calibration kernels without long-running streaming sims. add gate to rollout pipeline. :thumbsup:

kevin: filing follow-up tickets and will sync tomorrow with research & runtime team.

sam: great. i'll keep the fp16 routing live until kevin clears.

incident-bot: :information_source: Summary: calibration-int8 rollout caused KV dequant locking under long-stream concurrency -> tail stalls -> p99 SLO breach in eu-west-1. Live mitigation: route chat-stream to fp16 + partial rollback on canaries. Owners assigned for RCA and fixes.
